services.name: Sweet Mango Facial — $69
services.description: A brightening mango enzyme facial that lifts summer dullness and rehydrates — $69 instead of $85.
services.fullDescription:
A facial built around mango enzymes, which loosen dead surface skin without scrubbing.

The treatment runs a full cleanse, aroma steam, mango enzyme exfoliation, extractions where needed, a face and neck massage, and a hydrating mask. Skin comes out brighter, softer and noticeably more even in tone.

This is the one to book if summer left your face dull, dry or uneven. It suits nearly every skin type, including sensitive skin, and there is no downtime.

Regularly $85. Fall price is $69 through Monday, October 26.
benefits: Mango enzyme exfoliation — no harsh scrubbing

services.name: Microneedling — $179
services.description: Collagen-induction microneedling for firmer skin, softer lines and smoother texture — $179 instead of $250.
services.fullDescription:
Microneedling works by creating controlled micro-channels in the skin, which triggers your own collagen and elastin production over the following weeks.

It is the treatment people book for fine lines, acne scarring, enlarged pores and general loss of firmness. A numbing cream goes on first, so the session itself is comfortable, and a calming serum and mask finish the treatment.

Expect mild redness for about 24 hours, then a steady improvement in tone and texture over the next four to six weeks. Most clients do a series of three sessions spaced a month apart, and fall is the right time to start — results land in time for the holidays.

Regularly $250. Fall price is $179 through Monday, October 26.
benefits: Stimulates your own collagen and elastin
Softens fine lines, scarring and large pores
Numbing cream applied first for comfort

services.name: Underarm Laser Hair Removal — $59
services.description: A full underarm laser hair removal session for $59 — normally $75.
services.fullDescription:
A complete underarm laser session at fall pricing.

Treatments take about 15 minutes and use the same medical-grade laser and the same technique as every other area on our menu.

Laser works on a schedule — sessions run four to six weeks apart, so starting now means real results well before next summer. If you have never had laser with us, Laura will check your skin and hair type first and tell you honestly how many sessions your area will need.

Regularly $75. Fall price is $59 through Monday, October 26.

services.name: Body Scrub with Shower + Express Facial — $99

Head-to-toe in one appointment.

Start with a full-body scrub — exfoliation from shoulders to feet, lifting away the dry, flaking skin summer leaves behind — followed by a warm shower and a hydrating finish. Skin feels polished and soft immediately.

Then an express facial: cleanse, aroma steam, light exfoliation and a hydrating mask to bring the same freshness to your face.

It is the treatment to book when you want everything taken care of at once.
